name: go-network
description: Moteur d'inférence Zig/WASM sans allocation pour le modèle Moka 9×9

scripts.build: zig build models wasm wasm-safe wasm-profile && pnpm build:js
scripts.oracle: zig build models && pnpm build:js && node scripts/run-oracle.mjs
scripts.oracle:check: zig build models && pnpm build:js && node scripts/run-oracle.mjs --check
scripts.test: zig build test && zig build models wasm wasm-safe wasm-profile && node --test "tests/*.test.mjs" "tests/*.test.ts"
scripts.bench: zig build models wasm wasm-profile && pnpm build:js && node bench/run.mjs
scripts.check:all: pnpm typecheck && pnpm gen && pnpm build && pnpm models:check && pnpm oracle && pnpm oracle:check && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e
